module: Core of the World Editor: defines the global `editor` (editor = M). It loads all the extensions in lua/ge/extensions/editor/ (those containing "M.onEditor" or "M.onExtension", except editor_main), initializes the editor/api/* modules, manages the preferences (settings/editor/preferences.json), the state (settings/editor/currentState.json) and the activation/deactivation of the editor (free camera, action maps, hidden CEF, layout, audio). The other editor extensions add their functions to the `editor` table.
usage:
editor_main.toggleActive()          -- opens/closes the editor
editor.logInfo("message")
local v = editor.getPreference("camera.general.freeCameraMoveSpeed")
notes: setEditorActive does not toggle immediately: it sets a request processed in onUpdate after 3 frames of loading screen (splash).
Closing the editor is refused (silent return) if editor.anyToolDirty() is true.
Safe mode (safeMode): only the extensions in the safeModeExtensionNames list are loaded.
An extension can be disabled via settings/editor/extensions.json (key = short name, field disabled).
editor.setPreference and editor.getPreference are only defined after the first loadPreferences().
The same script also handles the automatic launch with the -worldEditor argument (onFirstUpdate) and the reactivation after a Lua reload (onSerialize/onDeserialized).

initialized.desc: True when the editor extensions are loaded and initialized.

active.desc: True when the editor is active (open).

safeMode.desc: True if the editor was launched in safe mode.

extensionNames.desc: Names (editor_xxx) of the editor extensions currently loaded.

allExtensionNames.desc: Short names of all the editor extensions found on disk.

additionalActionMaps.desc: Additional action maps pushed when the editor is activated and popped when it is deactivated.

log.desc: Writes an Info-level message to the log, tag "editor".

loadPreferences.desc: Reloads the preferences from settings/editor/preferences.json, defines editor.setPreference/getPreference and migrates the old preferences.

loadExtensionsSettings.desc: Reads settings/editor/extensions.json into editor.extensionsSettings (empty table if absent).

loadEditorExtension.desc: Hot-loads an editor extension: registers its preferences, then calls its onEditorRegisterApi, onEditorInitialized and onEditorActivated.

returns.desc: The extension table, or nil if loading failed.

loadEditorExtensions.desc: Loads several editor extensions at once (preferences registered first, then RegisterApi/Initialized/Activated hooks for each).

unloadEditorExtension.desc: Unloads a loaded editor extension: calls its onEditorDeactivated then onEditorShutdown, then extensions.unload.

initializeModules.desc: Loads and initializes the editor/api/* modules (gui, core, assets, camera, dataBlock, decal, gizmo, material, navigation, object, roadRiver, sketch, terrain, forest, proceduralContentGenerator), then emits onEditorModulesInitialized. No effect if already done.

saveState.desc: Saves the editor state: emits onEditorSaveState(state) then writes the JSON. No effect if the editor was not initialized in this session.

loadState.desc: Reads the editor state file (warns if the format version differs).

returns.desc: The state read, or an empty table.

setEditorActive.desc: Requests the activation or deactivation of the editor; applied in onUpdate after a few splash frames.

activate.desc: true to open, false to close.

safeMode.desc: true to start in safe mode.

toggleActive.desc: Toggles the editor's active state (via setEditorActive).

isEditorActive.desc: Returns whether the editor is active.

shutdown.desc: Closes the editor, emits onEditorShutdown, unloads all the editor extensions and sets initialized/active back to false.

onClientStartMission.desc: Called when a level starts: sets initialized and modulesInitialized back to false and reapplies the current active state.

onClientEndMission.desc: Called at the end of a level: saves the state, shows the apps again (ShowApps), offers to save if modified, then shutdown().

onPreWindowClose.desc: Called before the game window closes: editor.checkDirtyAndSave() if available.

onPreExit.desc: Called before the game exits. Empty body.

onExit.desc: Called when the game exits: sets editor.active to false and saves the state.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: processes the activation/deactivation request (shows the editorSplash.png loading image for 3 frames, then applies).

onSerialize.desc: Called before a Lua reload: saves the camera, active state, dirty, headless, edit mode, window positions and the cleanExit preference; deactivates the editor.

onDeserialized.desc: Called after a Lua reload: restores active/dirty/headless/edit mode and exposes the data in editor_main.serializedData.

onFirstUpdate.desc: Called on the first update: reactivates the editor if it was active before the reload, and opens it automatically if the game was launched with -worldEditor.
